title: Top Blenders for Smoothies, Soups & Ice (2026)
summary: We compared the countertop blenders that testers keep recommending in 2026. The Vitamix Ascent X5 leads for all-round performance, the Breville Super Q makes the silkiest drinks, the Vitamix Explorian E310 gives the best long-term value, and the Ninja TWISTi is the best budget pick for everyday smoothies.
method: We focused on blenders that more than one trusted review praised for smoothness, power, ease of cleaning and durability, then ranked them by overall results and value.
assumptions: Prices change often, so check Amazon for today's price. Cheaper blenders can make good smoothies but struggle more with ice and hot soup.

products.name: Vitamix Ascent X5
why: Vitamix's top-end Ascent line is a staple in multiple 2026 reviews for smooth smoothies, hot soups and frozen drinks.
Vitamix backs its blenders with a long warranty, which is why many cooks treat them as a buy-it-once appliance.
pros: Handles ice and frozen fruit with ease
cons: Tall container can be hard to fit under cabinets
products.best_for: Daily smoothie and soup makers who want the best result
products.skip_if: You blend only occasionally or have a tight budget

products.name: Breville Super Q
why: Testers called it the best blender ever used, producing silkiest beverages and purees.
It handled soups, frozen cocktails, and nut butters with ease, achieving smooth consistency without added oil.
specs: No need for coconut oil in nut butter
cons: Large and heavy on the counter
products.best_for: Home chefs who want professional‑grade results and are willing to invest
products.skip_if: You’re looking for a budget or portable blender

products.name: Vitamix Explorian E310 Blender
why: Testers praised its durable construction and consistent smooth results across all recipes.
It offers a 5‑year free warranty and blends everything into a smooth consistency.
cons: Loud at high speed, as with most high-power blenders
products.best_for: Users who want a reliable, long‑lasting blender that delivers professional results
products.skip_if: You need a very low‑budget option

products.name: Ninja TWISTi Blender
why: Among high‑rated Ninja models, the TWISTi performed best even at a lower price point.
Its versatility and multiple container sizes make it suitable for large batches and single‑serve convenience.
products.best_for: Budget‑conscious users who want a versatile blender for everyday use
products.skip_if: You require professional‑grade performance or high‑speed blending
